title: The beginning of our travels
body: Today marks the start of our grand adventure, filled with excitement and a touch of nervousness. We packed our bikes and essentials, ready to embrace the open road and the unknown ahead.

title: Cycling from Paris to Leon
body: The journey from Paris to Leon was both challenging and exhilarating, with breathtaking views along the way. We stopped at a quaint village for lunch, savoring local delicacies and the warmth of the people.

title: Still on the way to Leon
body: Despite sore legs, the ride today was rewarding, with scenic trails and moments of quiet reflection. A sudden rain shower added an unexpected twist, but it only made the journey more memorable.
